item.title: No suspects as search for Nancy Guthrie continues
item.description: The Pima County Sheriff’s Department pushed back against some reports in the search for 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie, saying there is no suspect and no person of interest identified in the case.

item.title: President Trump directing federal resources to Tucson; FBI Director Kash Patel coming to Arizona
item.description: President Donald Trump announced on social media that he is directing federal resources to Tucson to assist in the search for Nancy Guthrie, NBC's 'TODAY' co-anchor Savannah Guthrie's mother.

item.title: Students From Flowing Wells & Amphi High Schools unite in walkout against ICE
item.description: Students from Flowing Wells and Amphitheater high schools joined together in a walkout protest on Tucson's northside, speaking against ICE's actions toward the immigrant community.
